name: partnercentral-benefits
description: AWS Partner Central Benefits Service provides APIs for managing partner benefits, applications, and allocations within the AWS Partner Network ecosystem.

subcommands.name: amend-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Modifies an existing benefit application by applying amendments to specific fields while maintaining revision control.

subcommands.name: associate-benefit-application-resource
subcommands.description: Links an AWS resource to an existing benefit application for tracking and management purposes.

subcommands.name: cancel-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Cancels a benefit application that is currently in progress, preventing further processing.

subcommands.name: create-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Creates a new benefit application for a partner to request access to AWS benefits and programs.

subcommands.name: disassociate-benefit-application-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association between an AWS resource and a benefit application.

subcommands.name: get-benefit
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific benefit available in the partner catalog.

subcommands.name: get-benefit-allocation
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific benefit allocation that has been granted to a partner.

subcommands.name: get-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific benefit application.

subcommands.name: list-benefit-allocations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of benefit allocations based on specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: list-benefit-applications
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of benefit applications based on specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: list-benefits
subcommands.description: Retrieves a paginated list of available benefits based on specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves all tags associated with a specific resource.

subcommands.name: recall-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Recalls a submitted benefit application, returning it to draft status for further modifications.

subcommands.name: submit-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Submits a benefit application for review and processing by AWS.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes specified tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-benefit-application
subcommands.description: Updates an existing benefit application with new information while maintaining revision control.
